captions.caption: A man in a jacket stands in a forest talking to the camera.
Text overlay "toggles AND pegs" appears as the man continues speaking.
The man looks around the forest while explaining his task.
A dog is seen sitting on a fallen log in the background.
The camera pans to show a green tarp shelter among the trees.
The man approaches his large green backpack near the shelter.
The man leans over and starts searching through his backpack.
The man continues looking for tools inside his gear bag.
The man pulls a saw and an axe out of the backpack.
The man puts the axe into a holster on his belt.
The man stands up with his tools and prepares to head out.
The man begins walking away from the campsite area.
The man walks past the camera into the woods.
The dog sits alertly on the log, watching the man.
The dog looks directly at the camera as the man returns.
The man walks back toward the dog and reaches out.
The man pats the dog's head and encourages him to move.
The man gestures for the dog to follow him into the trees.
The dog jumps down from the log and follows the man.
The man and his dog walk further into the forest.
The man approaches a fallen tree to gather wood.
The man inspects the branches on the ground for suitable pieces.
The man prepares his folding saw to cut a branch.
The man starts sawing a thin branch while the dog watches.
The man continues sawing the branch with steady motions.
The man saws through the branch and it falls to the ground.
The dog sniffs around the area while the man works.
The man begins sawing another part of the fallen tree.
The man continues sawing as the dog stands close by.
The man works on cutting another section of the branch.
The man finishes the cut and moves to a new section.
The man holds a piece of wood he has just cut.
The man starts sawing a third piece from the branch.
The dog barks and gets excited while the man saws.
The man continues sawing despite the dog's barking.
The man finishes sawing through the wood piece.
The man breaks off a piece of wood with his hands.
The man starts sawing another branch section vigorously.
The man continues sawing through the wood quickly.
The man finishes the cut and prepares to move.
The man uses his boot to snap a branch on the ground.
The man gathers several cut wood pieces in his hand.
The dog watches the man pick up the wood pieces.
The man inspects the wood he has collected.
The man starts sawing a smaller section of wood.
The dog barks and moves around the man as he works.
The man finishes the final cut for this session.
The scene changes to the man back at the camp log.
The man places a wood piece on the log to split it.
The man strikes the wood with his axe to split it.
The man continues splitting the wood piece with the axe.
The man picks up the smaller split pieces of wood.
The man begins to carve a point on a wood piece.
The man uses the axe to carefully shape the wood.
The man continues carving and refining the wood peg.
The man strikes the wood against the log to split it.
The dog barks off-camera while the man works.
The man tells the dog to stay back for safety.
The man continues to shape the wood piece on the log.
The man strikes the wood with his axe to finish splitting it.
